#nullable enable
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Collections;
using System.Reflection;

namespace __RUNTIME_NAMESPACE__.Http;

public sealed record HttpResult<T>(HttpStatusCode StatusCode, T? Value, string? RawText,
    bool? ServerSuccess = null, JsonElement? Errors = null)
{
    public bool Success => (int)StatusCode is >= 200 and < 300 && ServerSuccess != false;
}

public abstract class HttpRouteClient
{
    protected HttpClient Client { get; }
    protected string BaseUrl { get; }

    protected HttpRouteClient(HttpClient? client = null, string? baseUrl = null)
    {
        Client = client ?? new HttpClient();
        BaseUrl = baseUrl?.TrimEnd('/') ?? "";
    }

    protected async Task<HttpResult<T>> SendJsonAsync<T>(HttpMethod method, string path,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?>? body = null, bool useFormData = false,
        bool unwrapResult = false,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        using var request = NewRequest(method, path, body, useFormData);
        using var response = await Client.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
        var raw = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);
        T? value = default;
        bool? serverSuccess = null;
        JsonElement? errors = null;
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(raw))
        {
            try
            {
                using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(raw);
                var root = document.RootElement;
                if (root.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object &&
                    root.TryGetProperty("Success", out var success) && root.TryGetProperty("Errors", out var errorList))
                {
                    serverSuccess = success.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.True;
                    errors = errorList.Clone();
                    if (unwrapResult && root.TryGetProperty("Result", out var resultValue))
                        value = Deserialize<T>(resultValue.GetRawText());
                    else if (!unwrapResult) value = Deserialize<T>(raw);
                }
                else if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode) value = Deserialize<T>(raw);
            }
            catch (JsonException) when (response.IsSuccessStatusCode && typeof(T) == typeof(string) && !unwrapResult)
            {
                value = (T)(object)raw;
            }
            catch (JsonException) when (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode) { }
            catch (TargetInvocationException) when (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode) { }
        }
        var answer = new HttpResult<T>(response.StatusCode, value, raw, serverSuccess, errors);
        return answer;
    }

    protected async Task<HttpResult<string>> SendTextAsync(HttpMethod method, string path,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?>? body = null, bool useFormData = false,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        using var request = NewRequest(method, path, body, useFormData);
        using var response = await Client.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
        var raw = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);
        var answer = new HttpResult<string>(response.StatusCode, raw, raw);
        return answer;
    }

    protected async Task<HttpResult<byte[]>> SendBytesAsync(HttpMethod method, string path,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?>? body = null, bool useFormData = false,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        using var request = NewRequest(method, path, body, useFormData);
        using var response = await Client.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
        var raw = await response.Content.ReadAsByteArrayAsync(cancellationToken);
        var answer = new HttpResult<byte[]>(response.StatusCode, raw, null);
        return answer;
    }

    protected async Task<HttpResult<object>> SendVoidAsync(HttpMethod method, string path,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?>? body = null, bool useFormData = false,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        using var request = NewRequest(method, path, body, useFormData);
        using var response = await Client.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken);
        var raw = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken);
        bool? serverSuccess = null;
        JsonElement? errors = null;
        try
        {
            using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(raw);
            var root = document.RootElement;
            if (root.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object &&
                root.TryGetProperty("Success", out var success) && root.TryGetProperty("Errors", out var errorList))
            {
                serverSuccess = success.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.True;
                errors = errorList.Clone();
            }
        }
        catch (JsonException) { }
        var answer = new HttpResult<object>(response.StatusCode, null, raw, serverSuccess, errors);
        return answer;
    }

    private HttpRequestMessage NewRequest(HttpMethod method, string path,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?>? body, bool useFormData)
    {
        var request = new HttpRequestMessage(method, BaseUrl + path);
        if (body == null) return request;
        if (useFormData)
        {
            var form = new MultipartFormDataContent();
            foreach (var (key, value) in body)
                AddFormValue(form, key, value);
            request.Content = form;
        }
        else request.Content = new StringContent(Serialize(body), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
        return request;
    }

    private static void AddFormValue(MultipartFormDataContent form, string key, object? value)
    {
        if (value is HttpUpload upload)
        {
            var content = new ByteArrayContent(upload.Content);
            content.Headers.ContentType = new System.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeHeaderValue(upload.ContentType);
            form.Add(content, key, upload.FileName);
        }
        else if (value is IEnumerable sequence && value is not string && value is not byte[])
        {
            var index = 0;
            foreach (var item in sequence) AddFormValue(form, key + "[" + index++ + "]", item);
        }
        else if (value != null && value.GetType().IsClass && value is not string && value is not byte[] &&
            value.GetType().Namespace?.StartsWith("System", StringComparison.Ordinal) != true)
        {
            foreach (var property in value.GetType().GetProperties(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance)
                .Where(property => property.CanRead && property.GetIndexParameters().Length == 0))
                AddFormValue(form, key + "." + property.Name, property.GetValue(value));
        }
        else form.Add(new StringContent(value is string text ? text : Serialize(value)), key);
    }

    private static readonly Type? JsonConvert = Type.GetType("Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert, Newtonsoft.Json");
    private static readonly MethodInfo? SerializeMethod = JsonConvert?.GetMethods(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static)
        .FirstOrDefault(method => method.Name == "SerializeObject" &&
            !method.IsGenericMethod && method.GetParameters().Length == 1);
    private static readonly MethodInfo? DeserializeMethod = JsonConvert?.GetMethods(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static)
        .FirstOrDefault(method => method.Name == "DeserializeObject" && method.IsGenericMethodDefinition &&
            method.GetParameters().Length == 1 && method.GetParameters()[0].ParameterType == typeof(string));
    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions JsonOptions = new() { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };

    private static string Serialize(object? value) => SerializeMethod?.Invoke(null, [value]) as string ??
        JsonSerializer.Serialize(value, JsonOptions);

    private static T? Deserialize<T>(string json)
    {
        if (typeof(T) != typeof(JsonElement) && DeserializeMethod != null)
            return (T?)DeserializeMethod.MakeGenericMethod(typeof(T)).Invoke(null, [json]);
        return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(json, JsonOptions);
    }
}
